project_context.name: Krishnendu Healthcare Private Limited (KHPL)
project_context.domain: B2B Contract/Private-Label Manufacturer of Wet Wipes, Personal Hygiene, Cosmetics, Pet Care
project_context.vibe: Awwwards-level editorial design. Medical precision meets warm human care. White canvas with bold orange accents.
project_context.theme: Light mode only (Clinical, clean, authoritative). No dark mode to maintain the clean room aesthetic.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Highly distinctive, premium corporate feel. Do not use Inter or Roboto.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, and UI text.

primary.description: Brand orange. Use for CTAs, active states, key highlights.

background.description: Crisp white canvas for that clean-room/laboratory feel.

foreground.description: Deep black for high contrast readability.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay on specific solid color sections to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (#E5E5E5) for grids, cards, and structured bento layouts.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating navigation and dropdowns only. Cards should be flat with 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl for cards to match the logo's rounded square shape. rounded-full for pill-shaped buttons.

motion.reveals: Use framer-motion for masked line-by-line text reveals on headings (Kinetic Hero).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero images and large background assets.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for slow, editorial ribbon showing certifications (FDA, Sedex, ISO) or product capabilities.
motion.hover: Image zoom on hover within clipped/spotlight frames. Buttons should scale down slightly (scale-95) on press.

layouts.hero: Kinetic layout. Large bold H1, masked text reveal, overlapping clipped image frames. High negative space.
layouts.services_grid: Bento grid protocol (Mode A: Tetris Grid). Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create asymmetry and visual tension.
layouts.navigation: Sticky/Fixed header (z-50) using Glassmorphism (Crystal variant: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-white/40). Includes Services dropdown and CTA.
layouts.footer: Massive spacing (py-20 to py-32). Deep orange background to contrast with the light theme body. Giant typography for 'Let's Talk'.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: Orange bg, white text. Secondary: Outline with 1px border. Add hover transition (transform, bg-color).
components.cards: Flat design, no shadow. 1px border. Internal padding generous (p-8 or p-12).
components.dropdowns: Shadcn UI Menu/Dropdown. Must have solid or highly blurred glass background. NO purely transparent backgrounds.
components.forms: Shadcn Input/Textarea with flat aesthetic. Focus rings should be brand orange.
components.marquee_ribbon: Editorial Ribbon. Pale orange background (#FFF0E8) with brand orange text, slow drift, wide gaps.

images.instructions: Use these provided URLs. Apply grayscale + orange duotone or full color depending on the emotional contrast needed. Never use placeholder text for images.

pages: Home: Kinetic hero, Editorial marquee (certifications), Bento grid of categories, Mission/Vision manifesto.
About Us: Brand story, clean room manufacturing facility shots.
Capabilities: Details on clean rooms, EDI system, QC labs.
Contact Us: Contact form, location details.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over orange meets APCA/WCAG ratios. Orange (#F26522) with white text is usually AA for large text.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Import Cabinet Grotesk and Manrope from Fontsource or Google Fonts into your CSS.
COLORS: Update tailwind.config.js theme block with the custom KHPL orange (#F26522) under 'primary' and set dark/light theme variables in index.css.
SPACING: Apply generous spacing (p-8 to p-24) to create a premium editorial feel.
COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, and navigation dropdowns. Customize them to remove the default 'Vercel' look (e.g., make borders 1px solid, use brand colors).
DO NOT use generic center-aligned layouts for text. Left-align text for better reading flow, use asymmetry.
DO NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components.
Header MUST be sticky with a glassmorphism effect (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md) so content underneath doesn't clash with links.
Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals and page transitions. Wrap grid items properly.
Ensure the application strictly operates in Light Theme for the clinical/clean room aesthetic. Do not use dark mode classes unless explicitly for contrast in specific sections like the footer.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
